critique: The still design strongly reads as a String Twist: thin luminous mint/cyan lines form a clean, broad symmetric wave, pinch tightly at the left and right twist nodes, and sit well against black. However, t1 and t4 remain visually identical. The attempted Flow X animation is not producing any observable deformation or travel, leaving the result frozen rather than behaving like an animated Form preset.

suggestions.why: Animate the Twister Amount itself, since Flow X has no visible rendered effect here; this should make the waist crossings and curved string spread visibly evolve between frames.
